summary: PASS. The fix for F-DG1-137/F-DG1-218 is verified on candidate 56f3eb88...2b4c (base 13418b8, freeze aa7d9a8). The change is test-only (architecture.testkit.ts and architecture.test.ts). syntaxErrors() (:492) now routes every name for which TypeScript's public SourceFile.isDeclarationFile is true (isDeclarationFileName, :452) to the no-emit declarationSyntaxErrors() (:466-481). Before/after was proved with the pre-fix testkit. Declaration files are still boundary-scanned, and nothing is emitted, written or executed. The public classification matches the @internal one over 31 names, and a mutant restoring the old regex turns the 2 new self-checks red. All checks are green on Node 22, and unit, architecture and integration also on Node 24: unit 325/325, architecture 132/132, integration 200/200 x3. One check is BLOCKED, as the assignment anticipates: AC-1 (effect) and the online install need a registry, and the offline sandboxed frozen install stands in for them. I raise no new findings.
